verdict.rationale: Fly.io's docs describe granting scoped, purpose-built access ('by Sprite name, by label, or down to a single endpoint') and credential rotation/revocation per Sprite, which maps to least-privilege credential issuance for agent workloads (Sprites). However this is marketing-page copy rather than detailed API/token documentation, and there's no independent or hands-on corroboration of how scoped tokens are actually created/managed via flyctl or the API. missing for 10: technical docs on token/macaroon scoping mechanics, hands-on or community verification that scoped credentials work as described, coverage of API-level (not just service-connection) credential scoping.
